citation: Clark & McCracken, Improving forecast accuracy by combining recursive and rolling forecasts
one_line: Blend of all-history and recent-window estimates beats either alone under structural change

citation: Giacomini & Rossi, Forecast comparisons in unstable environments (fluctuation test)
one_line: Test whether/when a model's edge holds over rolling sub-periods

citation: Rossi & Inoue, Out-of-sample forecast tests robust to the choice of window size

citation: Pesaran, Pick & Pranovich, Optimal forecasts in the presence of structural breaks

citation: Inoue, Jin & Rossi, Rolling window selection for out-of-sample forecasting with time-varying parameters
one_line: Choose window length by minimizing out-of-sample loss; asymptotically valid

citation: Falck, Rej & Thesmar, When do systematic strategies decay?
